resources.string: Google search, one corner swipe away.
Gesture enabled. Swipe inward from either bottom corner.
Connect your phone to a computer with USB debugging enabled, run this command, then return here. This permission remains after a restart.
In App info → Battery or Background activity, choose Unrestricted and confirm. Samsung may otherwise skip the startup broadcast.
Restore the original configuration in the previous helper before enabling SamsungCTS, so the two apps do not overwrite each other at startup.

Swipe inward and upward from either bottom corner. You can also use the quick settings tile or long-press the app icon. If Samsung asks you to choose an assistant for the first time, select Google, then return here and enable the gesture again. Holding the middle of the navigation bar keeps its original behavior.
Turn off startup recovery and restore the assistant and navigation settings saved before enabling SamsungCTS.
Google provides the search results and needs a working connection. SamsungCTS does not access the network, read your screen, or run a persistent service. Based on MiCTS; GPL-3.0.
